messages:
Tia Gomez: Quick sync — we need to lock the partner bundle SKU, telemetry contract wording, and final demo window for the joint launch with Databridge + VectorHub + the edge appliance. I put a proposed timeline in the doc: https://short.link/rdw-partner-timeline please skim by EOD.
Samir Patel: Can you call out the exact decisions we need from partnerships vs. product vs. legal?
Tia Gomez: Sure — partnerships: go/no-go on co-marketing assets and marketplace listing date; product: final feature flag list for the demo; legal: telemetry data capture language + customer-facing FAQ approval.
Olivia Chen: Telemetry note: vector payloads may include metadata that looks like PII. We need a safe-redaction approach and a line in the contract about sampling and retention.
Samir Patel: +1. Also need to confirm whether we ship the connector as a managed package or a sidecar installer for on-prem. That affects packaging SKU.
Marcus Rivera: Hardware team: appliance soak is scheduled Wed-Thu next week. Can we freeze the demo feature set by Monday so we test the combined flow (ingest -> embeddings -> query) under load?
Jordan Lee: Staging env status: we have shared staging for Databridge and VectorHub but the edge appliance sim is flaky. infra-bot just ran a deploy and reported one failing init job last night.
infra-bot: deploy:rdw-staging v1.12.3 — initialization failed on node-07 during volume attach. Logs: ```AttachError: device not found -> retrying``` — ops looking into it.
Tia Gomez: Marcus — can you prioritize a local appliance test harness for the Monday freeze? Jordan — please add a 'smoke checklist' that teams can run (5 items) and link it here.
Jordan Lee: Will do. Draft smoke checklist: 1) auth handshake 2) sample dataset ingest < 5m 3) embed generation 4) query p95 < 200ms 5) telemetry event recorded. I'll post it by EOB.
Olivia Chen: On telemetry capture: proposed contract language (draft): "Telemetry will be collected in aggregated form for performance and reliability analysis; any customer-provided content will be hashed and only stored for 30 days unless explicitly opted-in." Thoughts?
legal-bot: Required items for launch review: 1) Partner MOU with telemetry addendum 2) Marketplace terms for bundled SKU 3) Public FAQ and privacy FAQ 4) Joint press quote approval. Legal asks 5 business days for MOU turn.
Samir Patel: That timeline pushes our announcement. If legal needs 5 biz days, we should aim for a demo dry-run this week and final sign-off next Wednesday.
Tia Gomez: Proposal: dry-run Thurs, freeze Monday feature list, legal finalize MOU by next Wed, announce the following Tue. Does that work?
Marcus Rivera: Dry-run Thurs works if infra-bot clears the appliance attach by Wed. I'll escalate.
Jordan Lee: I'll post the smoke checklist in the channel and tag @everyone for the dry-run. Also, we should prep a fallback demo scenario that avoids the appliance (cloud-only) in case hardware isn't green.
Olivia Chen: Agree on fallback. Also request product to add a 'telemetry off' toggle for the demo to show privacy-safe flow.
Samir Patel: I'll update the release calendar and create a short shared checklist for partnerships (assets, marketplace tile, co-brand approval).
Tia Gomez: Thanks all. Action items: Samir — release calendar + marketplace SKU; Olivia — telemetry draft to legal; Marcus — appliance soak priority; Jordan — smoke checklist + fallback demo; legal-bot — confirm exact turn time for MOU. I'll round up comms copy after we have sign-off. :raised_hands:
Olivia Chen: quick note — cc: @security for telemetry encryption checks.
Marcus Rivera: pinging infra lead on pager. :phone: 
infra-bot: monitor:volume-attach node-07 — resolved. Reattached device, node healthy.
Samir Patel: ✅ Good news. I'll add Monday freeze and a Wed legal reminder to calendar.
Tia Gomez: Perfect. We'll reconvene Fri morning if any blockers show up. Thanks! :sparkles:
